audit: Generate the actual query fragmentations and obtain the fragment-based similarity. Check whether the reported best fragment belongs to that query fragmentation set,then apply the registered ring-cut validity predicate to that exact fragment. The predicate tests the supplied fragment;it does not generate cuts or certify whole-parent identity.
scope: A fragment-retrieval result only. Score1does not logically imply identical complete molecular graphs,formulae,physical properties or biological activity.
